hazards.location_in_image: Along both sides of the sidewalk

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Separation
hazards.description: There is no sidewalk or designated walking area, forcing pedestrians to walk in the same space as moving vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire paved area

hazards.name: Sidewalk Discontinuity
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the right appears to end or transition into a parking area without a clear, protected path to the houses.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side, midground

hazards.name: Sidewalk degradation
hazards.description: Visible cracks and vegetation growth in the sidewalk joints present minor trip hazards and indicate a need for maintenance.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground sidewalk area.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Calming
hazards.description: The straight, relatively wide roadway lacks physical measures to slow down vehicles in this residential area.
hazards.location_in_image: Center roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Installing bulb-outs at potential crossing points would shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implementing speed humps or cushions would help maintain low vehicle speeds appropriate for a residential neighborhood.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Marking crossings with high-visibility paint would clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a vegetated buffer zone between the curb and the sidewalk to separate pedestrians from moving vehicles and improve the microclimate.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Warning Signage
interventions.description: Install 'Pedestrian Crossing' signs to alert drivers on the major road to the potential presence of people crossing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add more frequent street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to physically slow traffic in this residential context.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Ensure the sidewalk material and level continue across the driveway to prioritize pedestrians and slow vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair cracked and uneven sidewalk panels to ensure a smooth, accessible walking surface.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming (Speed Humps)
interventions.description: Install speed humps or cushions to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential environment.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the asphalt to eliminate cracks and provide a smooth surface for all users.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near intersections or common crossing points to improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Install speed cushions or humps to physically slow vehicle traffic to residential speeds.

interventions.title: Street Tree Infill
interventions.description: Plant additional street trees to create a vertical sense of enclosure, which naturally encourages drivers to slow down.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant additional street trees in the buffer zone to create a vertical sense of enclosure and naturally slow traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Install a continuous sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way across the street.

interventions.title: Roadway Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway to eliminate cracks and provide a smooth, safe surface for all users.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer / Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a landscaped buffer or street trees between the curb and the sidewalk to provide physical and psychological separation from the roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Cut Consolidation
interventions.description: Reduce the width and frequency of driveway openings to minimize the number of conflict points where vehicles cross the walkway.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway to eliminate cracking and improve the surface for all users.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a dedicated, raised sidewalk along the perimeter to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during low-light conditions.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Continuity Improvements
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk or provide a clearly marked pedestrian walkway through the parking area to the building entrances.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair cracks and remove weeds to ensure a smooth, accessible surface for all users, including those with mobility aids.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Priority Driveway Design
interventions.description: Ensure driveways maintain the sidewalk level and material to signal to drivers that they are crossing a pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Street Buffer/Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.
